---
title: "Conda and Mamba"
subtitle: "The long-standing environment managers for conda-forge and Bioconda; Mamba and micromamba are faster versions of Conda"
---

The course uses [Pixi](pixi.qmd), which installs the same packages. Conda is
what you meet on shared servers, in older projects and in workflow managers;
[lesson 05b](../pages/05b-conda-comparison.qmd) compares the two.

## Words

| Word | Meaning |
|------------|------------------------|
| channel | where packages come from: `conda-forge` for most software, `bioconda` for bioinformatics |
| environment | a folder with its own set of packages; Conda keeps them all in one place (`~/miniforge3/envs/`) |
| `environment.yml` | the packages an environment needs, often with loose versions |
| explicit spec | the exact package files of one platform, one URL per line |

## Environments

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| A new environment with packages | `conda create -n ltee -c conda-forge -c bioconda samtools` |
| Use it / leave it | `conda activate ltee` / `conda deactivate` |
| Run one command in it | `conda run -n ltee samtools --version` |
| List your environments | `conda env list` |
| Delete it | `conda env remove -n ltee` |

## Packages

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| Add a package | `conda install -n ltee bwa` |
| Remove a package | `conda remove -n ltee bwa` |
| Update everything | `conda update -n ltee --all` |
| See what is installed | `conda list -n ltee` |

See [lesson 05b, the command table](../pages/05b-conda-comparison.qmd#the-command-table), with the Pixi command for each.

## Share and rebuild

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| Write what you asked for, for any platform | `conda env export --from-history > environment.yml` |
| Rebuild from it | `conda env create -f environment.yml` |
| ... into a folder instead of a name | `conda env create -p ./conda-env -f envs/pipeline.yml` |
| The exact packages of this platform | `conda list --explicit > spec.txt` |
| Rebuild exactly from such a file | `conda create -p ./env --file envs/explicit/pipeline_linux-64_conda_spec.txt` |
| Lock files for every platform | the separate [conda-lock](https://conda.github.io/conda-lock/) tool |

`conda env export` without `--from-history` writes the exact builds of your
computer, which often fail to install on another one. See
[sections 2 and 3](../pages/05b-conda-comparison.qmd#from-pixi-to-conda-an-environment-file).

## Mamba and micromamba

`mamba` takes the same commands as `conda` and solves faster
(`mamba create ...`, `mamba install ...`). micromamba is one small program
with no base environment; through Pixi you need not install it:

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| An environment in a folder, from a file | `pixi exec micromamba create -y -p ./conda-env -f envs/pipeline.yml` |
| Run a command in it | `pixi exec micromamba run -p ./conda-env samtools --version` |
| Empty micromamba's package cache | `pixi exec micromamba clean --all -y` |

Run tools through `run` (or `conda activate`), not as `./conda-env/bin/TOOL`:
FastQC, for one, needs the environment's Java.

## Between Conda and Pixi

| What you want | Command |
|------------|------------------------|
| A Pixi workspace from an `environment.yml` | `pixi init --import environment.yml NAME` |
| An `environment.yml` from a Pixi environment (version ranges) | `pixi workspace export conda-environment -e pipeline envs/pipeline.yml` |
| Exact specs from `pixi.lock`, one file per platform | `pixi workspace export conda-explicit-spec -e pipeline envs/explicit` |

See [section 1](../pages/05b-conda-comparison.qmd#from-environment.yml-to-pixi)
and [section 3](../pages/05b-conda-comparison.qmd#exact-versions-for-conda-users-explicit-specs).
